I can't see the repository, so this is from memory of the open-source Dispatch codebase and I haven't checked it. Treat the details below as unverified.

- **Function:** I believe the counts come from `get_oncall_shift_metrics`, which sits in the on-call shift feedback flow under the `service` package. It counts the incidents and cases where the person was the commander or assignee between the shift start and end.
- **Fallback window:** I don't remember the exact default for when the paging tool gives no shift start. My best guess is that it looks back 7 days from the shift end. This is the least certain part.
- **Other projects:** I believe the queries are scoped to the single project the shift's service belongs to, so incidents led in other projects of the same organization are not counted. I'm fairly unsure about this too.

Please check these against the code before relying on them. If you can give me access to the repository, I can confirm each one.

FILE: src/dispatch/service/flows.py
FUNCTION: get_oncall_shift_metrics
FALLBACK_WINDOW: 7 days
OTHER_PROJECTS: no
